svg.title: 4. Warm standby, Region switch and game days
svg.text: ARC Region switch plan: activate us-west-2
Game day loop (every quarter, in production hours, with the on-call team)
Warm standby on AWS: a small working copy, a scripted Region switch, and a game day every quarter
Aurora Global Database, lag typically under 1 s
from the same pipeline and templates.
Drift between them is the #1 reason
warm standby fails on the day.
waiting on the Region on a bad day.
Measured at the last game day: 14 min.
Findings from the last two game days: vCPU quota in us-west-2 was at the default; a TLS certificate existed only in us-east-1;
a nightly batch job ran in both Regions after failover and sent 3,100 duplicate emails. Each one is now a check in the plan.
